edges.reason: Arbitrary msg.sender may invoke the payable fallback and becomes buyer and ETH refund recipient.
block.timestamp decides which auction branch runs and whether the initial auction ended.
whichTick derives the metronome tick directly from block.timestamp and genesisTime.
whichAuction derives the auction index from a timestamp derived tick.
TokenLocker.withdraw uses now to compute elapsed quarters and vesting amounts.
subWithdrawFor uses now and block.timestamp to compute weeks elapsed and payout.
The fallback computes purchase price, tokens and refund through calcPurchase.
The fallback restarts the auction when the current auction advanced.
The fallback externally calls proceeds.closeAuction which can reenter conversion logic.
External value call to Proceeds.handleFund is an outbound call reachable mid-transaction.
ETH refund is sent to msg.sender with an external transfer call.
The fallback mints MET to the buyer through token.mint.
mintable quota is decremented by the number of tokens sold.
lastPurchasePrice is updated to the current unit price.
lastPurchaseTick is updated to the current tick.
purchaseInTheAuction tracks the per-address daily purchase amount.
lastPurchaseAuction records the auction index of the caller purchase.
calcPurchase prices post-initial-auction purchases with priceAt.
calcPurchase prices initial auction purchases with priceAtInitialAuction.
calcPurchase computes the refund with SafeMath.sub.
Loops of mul/div in priceAt are gas-unbounded and can overflow intermediate values.
Linear price decrease multiplies MULTIPLIER by numTicks and subtracts from last price.
calcPriceAt delegates to priceAt for daily auction pricing.
calcPriceAt delegates to priceAtInitialAuction for initial auction pricing.
restartAuction obtains the next auction supply before resetting state.
globalSupplyAfterPercentageLogic is incremented by the daily supply each restart.
Auction supply is scaled against the global supply constant.
Supply is derived from chained multiplications and divisions that can overflow.
mintInitialSupply mints founder and AC allocations through Mintable.mint.
Founder allocations are associated with lockers in the tokenLockers mapping.
Founder tokens are deposited into their TokenLocker.
initAuctions locks every founder TokenLocker.
genesisTime is derived from owner supplied start time or block.timestamp.
The non-original-chain init sets genesisTime from the supplied value.
minted flag prevents repeated initial founder minting.
initialized flag prevents repeated auction initialization.
createTokenLocker registers the deployed locker for the founder.
convert pulls MET via an external transferFrom before minting and redeeming.
convert mints smart tokens for the incoming deposit.
convert redeems smart tokens to produce the output reserve token.
redeem destroys the caller smart tokens before payout.
redeem performs an ETH sending external call to msg.sender.
redeem computes the payout with returnForRedemption.
AutonomousConverter.mint calls the smart token mint external function.
Smart token minting amount is computed by returnForMint.
convertEthToMet forwards to the shared convert routine.
convertMetToEth forwards to the shared convert routine.
msg.sender is the ETH depositor and recipient of minted MET.
msg.sender is the MET depositor and recipient of redeemed ETH.
handleFund checks msg.sender against the proceeds contract address.
closeAuction forwards ETH to the AutonomousConverter with an external value call.
latestAuctionClosed guards against closing the same auction twice.
Proceeds.handleFund restricts msg.sender to the Auctions contract.
onlyOwner compares msg.sender with owner before immediate ownership transfer.
Owned.changeOwnership is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
The owner state variable is reassigned during ownership transfer.
The pending newOwner state variable is written.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender to equal the pending newOwner.
The owner is replaced when the pending owner accepts.
The pending newOwner is read as the new owner.
Token.transfer debits the msg.sender balance keyed by the caller.
Token.transferFrom spends msg.sender allowance on behalf of the owner.
Balances are updated with SafeMath add and sub operations.
Balances are updated with SafeMath add and sub operations.
The allowance mapping is decremented by the transferred value.
approve writes the allowance of the spender for msg.sender.
multiTransfer loops over the internal transfer function.
enableMETTransfers irreversibly flips the transferAllowed gate.
enableMETTransfers queries auction state before enabling transfers.
subscribe writes the subscription record into the subs mapping.
subscribe requires the supplied start time to be at or after block.timestamp.
subWithdrawFor reads and updates the subscription record.
subWithdrawFor moves balances between subscriber and recipient.
multiSubWithdraw loops the internal subWithdrawFor routine.
METToken.importMET delegates to the external TokenPorter contract.
METToken.export delegates to the external TokenPorter contract.
importMET calls the external Validator to check receipt claimability.
importMET triggers external claiming of the burn hash in the Validator.
importMET mints the imported MET amount to the recipient.
importSequence is incremented for every successful import.
export burns the exported amount plus the fee from the token owner.
export registers the chain balance movement in the ChainLedger.
export appends the new burn hash to exportedBurns.
burnSequence is incremented after each export.
export records a claimable amount for same-chain destinations.
claimReceivables zeroes out claimed entries in the claimables mapping.
deposit is restricted to the Auctions contract and increases deposited.
withdraw updates lastWithdrawTime after computing vesting.
withdraw reduces the deposited amount by the withdrawable quantity.
withdraw transfers tokens to the owner via an external token call.
lockTokenLocker permanently sets the locked flag.
validateHash requires msg.sender to be a registered validator.
claimHash marks a hash claimed and is restricted to the token porter.
isReceiptClaimable counts validator attestations for the receipt hash.
threshold determines how many validator signatures are required.
registerExport moves chain balances with SafeMath add and sub.
registerImport moves chain balances with SafeMath add and sub.
returnForMint uses the fixed point square root in the bonding curve.
returnForMint chains fixed point multiplications via SafeMath.mul.
returnForRedemption subtracts fixed point terms via SafeMath.sub.
fSqrt squares values and loops, exposing overflow and gas concerns.
The _amount parameter is the MET input passed into convertMetToEth.
The _mintReturn parameter sets the minimum acceptable MET output of convertEthToMet.
The _wei parameter is the purchase amount fed into calcPurchase.
The _startTime parameter defines the subscription start validated in subscribe.
The _newOwner parameter is the target of an ownership transfer.
The recipients array drives the claimable clearing loop.
amountForPurchase is derived from msg.value inside the fallback.
withdrawable accumulates the vested amount during TokenLocker.withdraw.
weekElapsed drives the subscription payout in subWithdrawFor.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _amount only feeds convertMetToEth and should be folded into that core function node.
Parameter _mintReturn only constrains convertEthToMet and is normalized into it.
Parameter _startTime is used solely by the subscribe core function.
Parameter _payPerWeek is used solely by the subscribe core function.
Parameter _recipient is used solely by the subscribe core function.
Parameter _newOwner is the direct input of the ownership transfer function.
Parameter _founders is decoded only inside mintInitialSupply.
Parameter _owners is iterated only inside multiSubWithdraw.
Parameter _wei is the purchase amount consumed by calcPurchase.
Parameter _tick is the price query tick consumed by calcPriceAt.
Parameter _destChain is used only by TokenPorter.export.
Parameter _amount is burned only by TokenPorter.export.
Parameter recipients is iterated only by claimReceivables.
Parameter _minimumPrice is written to state only by initAuctions.
Parameter _fee is added to the burned amount only in TokenPorter.export.
Local amountForPurchase exists only inside the payable fallback.
Local excessAmount is computed and refunded only inside the fallback.
Local refund is produced and returned only inside the fallback.
Local tokens is the minted amount computed only inside the fallback.
Local weiPerToken is the unit price computed only inside the fallback.
Local withdrawable is accumulated only within TokenLocker.withdraw.
Local weekElapsed is computed only within subWithdrawFor.
Local amount is the subscription payout computed only within subWithdrawFor.
Local mult is the accumulated price multiplier of Pricer.priceAt.
